title: ScienceBoard: Evaluating Multimodal Autonomous Agents in Realistic Scientific Workflows
authors_zh: Qiushi Sun、Zhoumianze Liu、Chang Ma、Zichen Ding、Fangzhi Xu、Zhangyue Yin、Haiteng Zhao、Zhenyu Wu、Kanzhi Cheng、Zhaoyang Liu、Jianing Wang、Qintong Li、Xiangru Tang、Tianbao Xie、Xiachong Feng、Xiang Li、Ben Kao、Wenhai Wang、Biqing Qi、Lingpeng Kong、Zhiyong Wu
paper_type_zh: 科学工作流 computer-use 环境、基准与轨迹发布
best_for_zh: 研究科学智能体、GUI/CLI 混合操作、环境反馈、状态验证与可重放性的读者
one_line: ScienceBoard evaluates computer-use agents on 169 human-curated scientific workflows across six domains using a released Ubuntu VM, task-specific internal-state evaluators, and partially documented trajectory archives.
ScienceBoard 用 169 个六领域科学工作流任务、Ubuntu 科学软件 VM 和任务特定内部状态 evaluator 评测 computer-use agents，并公开环境、代码及部分轨迹压缩包。
why: It exposes professional scientific applications through GUI and CLI while validating workflow I/O and application-internal state, making verifier design and environment reproducibility central audit objects.
inclusion_reason: Directly relevant Track 6 environment and trajectory-feedback surface with scientific VM episodes, multi-interface action spaces, state-exposure plugins, task-specific environmental predicates, and released evaluation artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Scientific computer use is not well represented by static question answering or ordinary desktop benchmarks. Real workflows require specialized applications, domain-specific file formats, visual and textual reasoning, multi-step manipulation, and verification of intermediate I/O and final application state. A plausible screenshot or natural-language answer may still hide a scientifically incorrect configuration.

ScienceBoard combines a scientific-software environment with 169 human-curated evaluation tasks across algebra, biochemistry, theorem proving, geographic information systems, astronomy, and scientific documentation. The tasks include 38 GUI, 33 CLI, and 98 hybrid GUI+CLI workflows. Difficulty labels are 91 easy, 48 medium, 28 hard, and 2 open problems; the paper reports a nine-step average human execution and 124 seconds average time.

The episode is an interaction loop in an Ubuntu VMware VM. Given a natural-language goal, an agent observes screenshots, accessibility trees, or both; maintains recent interaction memory; and emits GUI, CLI, answer, or API actions until DONE, FAIL, or an attempt limit. A task-specific evaluator then inspects key workflow I/O and exposed VM/application state. The benchmark is evaluation-only; released trajectories do not establish a general training license or complete training corpus.

静态问答或普通桌面基准难以代表科学 computer use。真实工作流涉及专业软件、领域特定文件格式、视觉与文本推理、多步操作，以及对中间 I/O 和最终应用状态的验证。看似合理的截图或自然语言答案，仍可能掩盖错误的科学配置。

ScienceBoard 将科学软件环境与 169 个经人工策划的评测任务结合，覆盖代数、生物化学、定理证明、地理信息系统、天文学和科学文档六个领域。任务包括 38 个 GUI、33 个 CLI 和 98 个 GUI+CLI 混合工作流。难度分布为 91 个 easy、48 个 medium、28 个 hard 和 2 个开放问题；论文报告人工执行平均 9 步、平均耗时 124 秒。

episode 是 Ubuntu VMware VM 中的交互循环。智能体接收自然语言目标，观察截图、无障碍树或二者组合，维护近期交互记忆，并输出 GUI、CLI、答案或 API 动作，直到发出 DONE、FAIL 或达到尝试上限。随后任务特定 evaluator 检查关键工作流 I/O 及暴露的 VM/应用内部状态。该基准仅用于 evaluation；公开轨迹并不构成具有通用训练许可的完整训练语料。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ScienceBoard's key design is to make professional scientific software both operable and verifiable. It preinstalls tools such as ChimeraX, KAlgebra, Lean 4, GRASS GIS, Celestia, and TeXstudio in a VM and supports mouse/keyboard GUI control, Ubuntu commands, application-specific scripting, answer submission, and predefined API calls.

Visual success is not treated as sufficient. Lightweight servers or modified application builds expose internal state over HTTP. An initializer configures task context, such as a map or protein sequence; after the episode, evaluator templates compare expected and observed values using exact matches, ranges, numerical tolerance, file comparison, and application-specific predicates. The terminal outcome is therefore grounded in environment state rather than an LLM judge.

The data object has two layers. The benchmark layer consists of task JSON, assets, initializers, evaluator specifications, and VM snapshots. The trajectory layer consists of model-generated sequences of observations and actions plus result state. Five ZIP archives totaling about 9.42 GB are listed on Hugging Face, but the release does not provide a normalized record-level manifest that establishes episode counts, task coverage, failures, incompletes, or evaluator linkage.

ScienceBoard 的核心设计是让专业科学软件既可操作又可验证。它在 VM 中预装 ChimeraX、KAlgebra、Lean 4、GRASS GIS、Celestia 和 TeXstudio 等工具，并支持鼠标/键盘 GUI 控制、Ubuntu 命令、应用特定脚本、答案提交和预定义 API 调用。

视觉上看似成功并不足够。轻量服务器或经修改的应用构建通过 HTTP 暴露内部状态；initializer 配置地图、蛋白质序列等任务上下文；episode 结束后，evaluator 模板用精确匹配、范围、数值容差、文件比较和应用特定谓词对照期望值与实际值。因此，终止结果扎根于环境状态，而非 LLM judge。

数据对象分为两层。基准层包括任务 JSON、资产、initializer、evaluator 规格和 VM snapshot；轨迹层包括模型生成的观察—动作序列及结果状态。Hugging Face 列出 5 个 ZIP 压缩包，总计约 9.42 GB，但没有规范化的逐记录 manifest 来说明 episode 数量、任务覆盖、失败、不完整运行或 evaluator 对应关系。

title: Method
方法
html:
Five annotators first study tutorials and handbooks and explore unit operations in one scientific application. They draft configuration, question-answering, simulation, computation, documentation, and domain-expertise tasks. An OpenAI chat model standardizes task wording; annotators cross-check diversity, executability, and answer uniqueness before selection.

For every accepted task, annotators implement initialization functions that modify VM or application state and supply required files. They instantiate evaluator templates over exposed internal state and key workflow I/O. Each task is executed by two randomly selected annotators on separate VMs, including intentional attempts to deceive the evaluator, and the evaluator returns either task complete or task fail. Exact/range comparisons and numerical tolerance are examples; the contract can also inspect files and application-specific state.

At run time, the agent receives text-only accessibility trees, screenshots, their combination, or Set-of-Marks observations. GUI actions cover mouse movement, clicks, and keystrokes; CLI actions cover terminal commands and application scripting. ANS, call_api, WAIT, DONE, and FAIL extend the action space. Scientific software returns an updated state after each action, and recent observations/actions form memory.

The public stack comprises the GitHub code/tasks, a 17.1 GB VM.zip, modified-application/plugin links, and a 9.42 GB trajectory repository with five archives for GPT-4o observation variants, a GPT-4o-to-GUI-Actor archive, and UI-TARS-1.5. Exact code commit, VM snapshot ID, application/plugin revisions, episode schema, attempt budget, API settings, and task-to-archive manifest are not pinned as one end-to-end release.

五名标注者先学习教程和手册，并探索某一科学应用的基本操作，再编写配置、问答、模拟、计算、文档和领域知识任务。OpenAI chat 模型统一任务表述；标注者交叉检查多样性、可执行性和答案唯一性后完成筛选。

对每个入选任务，标注者实现初始化函数，用于修改 VM 或应用状态并提供必要文件；随后把 evaluator 模板实例化为针对内部状态和关键工作流 I/O 的检查。每个任务由随机选择的两名标注者在独立 VM 上执行，也包括故意欺骗 evaluator 的尝试；evaluator 最终返回 task complete 或 task fail。精确/范围比较和数值容差是典型方式，也可检查文件与应用特定状态。

运行时，智能体接收纯文本无障碍树、截图、二者组合或 Set-of-Marks 观察。GUI 动作包括鼠标移动、点击和按键；CLI 动作包括终端命令与应用脚本；ANS、call_api、WAIT、DONE 和 FAIL 扩展了动作空间。每次动作后科学软件返回新状态，近期观察与动作组成记忆。

公开栈包括 GitHub 代码/任务、17.1 GB 的 VM.zip、修改应用或插件链接，以及包含 5 个压缩包、总计 9.42 GB 的轨迹仓库，覆盖 GPT-4o 多种观察设置、GPT-4o 到 GUI-Actor 和 UI-TARS-1.5。代码提交、VM snapshot ID、应用/插件修订、episode schema、尝试预算、API 设置及任务—压缩包 manifest 没有被固定成单一端到端发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The current arXiv v3 reports 169 unique tasks and the 38/33/98 GUI/CLI/hybrid distribution. Human performance is 60.27% overall. Under screenshot plus accessibility-tree observations, Claude-3.7-Sonnet reaches the best reported overall model success rate of 15.79%; GPT-4o reaches 14.45%, Gemini-2.0-Flash 12.32%, Qwen2.5-VL-72B 11.74%, and InternVL3-78B 3.20%.

Results vary materially with observation mode. Claude-3.7-Sonnet scores 10.48% using screenshots, 12.12% using accessibility trees, 15.79% using both, and 11.93% using Set-of-Marks. This supports the claim that environment representation affects agent performance, but it does not isolate data quality from model capability, prompt format, application reliability, or run variance.

The strongest verifier evidence is procedural rather than statistical: task evaluators query application/VM internal states; two annotators execute each task on separate VMs; and intentional adversarial attempts are included in validation. The paper does not report per-evaluator false-positive/false-negative rates, inter-run stability, or a complete evaluator test suite.

Artifact inspection confirms a public 17.1 GB VM archive with MIT metadata and five trajectory ZIPs totaling about 9.42 GB. The trajectory viewer exposes image/label examples and one train split, but viewer structure is not a benchmark train split and does not prove complete retention of all model successes, failures, timeouts, or evaluator outputs.

当前 arXiv v3 报告 169 个唯一任务，以及 38/33/98 的 GUI/CLI/混合分布；人工总体成功率为 60.27%。在截图加无障碍树观察下，Claude-3.7-Sonnet 取得报告中最高的模型总体成功率 15.79%；GPT-4o 为 14.45%，Gemini-2.0-Flash 为 12.32%，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 为 11.74%，InternVL3-78B 为 3.20%。

结果随观察模式明显变化。Claude-3.7-Sonnet 在纯截图、纯无障碍树、二者组合和 Set-of-Marks 下分别为 10.48%、12.12%、15.79% 和 11.93%。这支持环境表示会影响智能体表现，但不能把数据质量与模型能力、提示格式、应用可靠性或运行方差分离。

最强的 verifier 证据来自流程而非统计：任务 evaluator 查询应用/VM 内部状态；每个任务由两名标注者在独立 VM 上执行；验证还包括故意对抗 evaluator 的尝试。论文没有报告逐 evaluator 的假阳性/假阴性率、跨运行稳定性或完整 evaluator 测试套件。

制品检查确认公开了带 MIT 元数据的 17.1 GB VM 归档，以及总计约 9.42 GB 的 5 个轨迹 ZIP。轨迹 viewer 展示 image/label 示例和一个 train split，但 viewer 结构不是基准训练划分，也不能证明所有模型成功、失败、超时或 evaluator 输出均被完整保留。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
ScienceBoard moves scientific-agent evaluation from answer-only scoring into executable professional workflows. Its distinctive element is application instrumentation: lightweight servers and modified builds expose scientific state that ordinary screenshots and accessibility trees cannot reliably verify. This permits task-specific checks over molecules, GIS layers, celestial simulation time, proof state, files, and documents.

The same environment supports GUI, CLI, and hybrid episodes instead of treating them as separate benchmarks. Agents can switch between visual manipulation, terminal commands, application scripting, answers, and APIs while being evaluated against a shared initialized state. Cross-application documentation tasks additionally test whether experimental outputs can be turned into reports.

This is a benchmark and environment contribution, not evidence that released trajectories are training-ready. Environmental predicates are stronger than visual plausibility for their encoded state, but only cover properties the task author exposes and specifies. Unchecked scientific semantics, side effects, and provenance can remain outside the verifier boundary.

ScienceBoard 把科学智能体评测从只看答案推进到可执行的专业工作流。其突出之处是应用插桩：轻量服务器和修改后的应用构建暴露截图与无障碍树难以可靠验证的科学状态，从而能针对分子、GIS 图层、天体模拟时间、证明状态、文件和文档编写任务特定检查。

同一环境同时支持 GUI、CLI 和混合 episode，而不是把它们拆成不同基准。智能体可在视觉操作、终端命令、应用脚本、答案和 API 之间切换，同时基于共享的初始化状态接受评估。跨应用文档任务还检查能否把实验输出转化为报告。

这是一项基准与环境贡献，不代表公开轨迹已适合训练。环境谓词对其编码的状态比视觉合理性更强，但只能覆盖任务作者已经暴露和指定的属性；未检查的科学语义、副作用和来源仍可能落在 verifier 边界之外。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Reproducibility depends on several mutable components: repository code, task JSON, the VMware image, OSWorld-derived runtime, scientific applications, modified plugins, external APIs, and model endpoints. The release does not bind them with one tag or manifest. Reset semantics are only partially operationalized through initializers and snapshots; authentication, startup timing, missing accessibility trees, hardware performance, and external downloads can change feasibility.

No official train/dev/test split or decontamination audit is reported. All 169 tasks are an evaluation set, and public exposure creates future contamination risk. The paper does not measure overlap with scientific tutorials, model training data, OSWorld tasks, or other science benchmarks. The Hugging Face viewer's train label should not be interpreted as an endorsed training partition.

Trajectory retention is under-documented. Five ZIP archives are public, but there is no record-level inventory with task ID, model/API revision, observation condition, seed, actions, timestamps, evaluator output, terminal reason, success, failure, timeout, or corruption status. Consequently, the balance of successful and failed episodes and preservation of intermediate artifacts cannot be audited.

The GitHub repository and environment page declare MIT, while the trajectory page has no visible license declaration. VMware, scientific applications, plugins, task assets, screenshots, and generated traces may carry separate rights. Privacy procedures for screenshots, terminal logs, downloaded data, API prompts, and secrets are undisclosed. The README recommends environment variables for API keys but provides no complete redaction audit.

Agents receive broad VM powers, including terminal commands, application scripting, APIs, and a documented VM password for sudo in the evaluation prompt. Malware/download isolation, network allowlists, credential separation, resource limits, and incident recovery are not specified. Scientific errors may also propagate into files or reports even when encoded evaluator predicates pass.

复现依赖多个可变组件：仓库代码、任务 JSON、VMware 镜像、OSWorld 派生运行时、科学应用、修改插件、外部 API 和模型端点。发布没有用统一 tag 或 manifest 绑定它们。重置语义仅通过 initializer 和 snapshot 部分实现；认证、启动时序、无障碍树缺失、硬件性能和外部下载都可能改变可行性。

论文没有报告正式 train/dev/test 划分或去污染审计。全部 169 个任务构成评测集，公开后会带来未来污染风险；也没有测量其与科学教程、模型训练数据、OSWorld 任务或其他科学基准的重合。Hugging Face viewer 的 train 标签不能被理解为官方认可的训练划分。

轨迹保留说明不足。虽然公开了 5 个 ZIP，但没有逐记录清单列出任务 ID、模型/API 修订、观察条件、种子、动作、时间戳、evaluator 输出、终止原因、成功、失败、超时或损坏状态。因此，成功与失败 episode 的比例及中间制品是否保留均不可审计。

GitHub 仓库与环境页声明 MIT，轨迹页面却没有可见许可声明。VMware、科学应用、插件、任务资产、截图和生成轨迹可能有独立权利。截图、终端日志、下载数据、API 提示和 secret 的隐私处理没有说明。README 建议用环境变量存 API key，但没有完整脱敏审计。

智能体拥有广泛 VM 权限，包括终端命令、应用脚本、API，以及评测提示中公开用于 sudo 的 VM 密码。恶意软件/下载隔离、网络白名单、凭据隔离、资源限制和事故恢复均未说明。即使编码的 evaluator 谓词通过，科学错误仍可能传播到文件或报告中。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, ScienceBoard provides a high-value example of environment-grounded feedback over professional software. The task object links a scientific instruction, assets, initialization, multi-interface actions, multimodal observations, internal state, and a terminal evaluator. This supports research on GUI/CLI planning, scientific tool use, verifier coverage, and environment failure.

Its intended released use is evaluation. The public VM and task code can run frozen agents, while the evaluator templates help compare environmental verification with screenshot-only or judge-based feedback. The trajectory archives may support qualitative error analysis, but absent manifest, licensing, and success/failure coverage prevent treating them as a clean SFT or preference corpus.

A careful reuse pipeline should pin every component, create fresh VM copies per episode, record initializer output, preserve all observations/actions/files and evaluator details, and retain failures and infrastructure exceptions. It should also define task splits, contamination policy, secret redaction, network restrictions, component licenses, and replay tests before producing any derivative training set.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 赛道而言，ScienceBoard 是专业软件环境反馈的重要案例。任务对象把科学指令、资产、初始化、多接口动作、多模态观察、内部状态和终止 evaluator 串联起来，可用于研究 GUI/CLI 规划、科学工具使用、verifier 覆盖和环境故障。

当前公开用途是 evaluation。公开 VM 与任务代码可运行冻结智能体，evaluator 模板则便于比较环境验证与只看截图或依赖 judge 的反馈。轨迹压缩包可支持定性错误分析，但缺少 manifest、许可和成功/失败覆盖信息，不能直接视为干净的 SFT 或偏好语料。

谨慎的复用流程应固定所有组件，为每个 episode 创建新的 VM 副本，记录 initializer 输出，保存全部观察、动作、文件和 evaluator 细节，并保留失败及基础设施异常。在生成任何派生训练集前，还应定义任务划分、污染策略、secret 脱敏、网络限制、组件许可和重放测试。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3–4 for the POMDP episode, observation/action spaces, application-state instrumentation, annotation pipeline, 169-task composition, and evaluator construction.
  • Separate benchmark objects from trajectory objects: task JSON, initializers, evaluators, and VM image are public; five trajectory ZIPs are listed, but record counts, complete success/failure coverage, and task-result linkage are unknown.
  • Interpret reported success as predicate coverage under a particular environment build. It does not prove complete scientific correctness, robust reset/replay, split hygiene, or trajectory suitability for training.
  • For reuse, pin code/VM/app/plugin/model versions; preserve failures and intermediate files; audit contamination, component rights, screenshots and secrets; and sandbox the sudo-capable VM and network.

• 阅读第 3–4 节以理解 POMDP episode、观察/动作空间、应用状态插桩、标注流水线、169 个任务组成和 evaluator 构造。
  • 区分基准对象与轨迹对象：任务 JSON、initializer、evaluator 和 VM 镜像公开；虽列出 5 个轨迹 ZIP，但记录数、完整成功/失败覆盖和任务—结果对应关系未知。
  • 把报告成功率理解为特定环境构建下的谓词覆盖，不能据此证明科学正确性完备、reset/replay 稳健、划分卫生或轨迹适合训练。
  • 复用时应固定代码/VM/应用/插件/模型版本，保留失败及中间文件，审计污染、组件权利、截图和 secret，并对具有 sudo 能力的 VM 与网络做隔离。
